title: fold away table
text: fold away table. Bought this table for my Mom who recently moved into a adult living apartment.  Her space is limited and she wanted a multi purpose table.  This table fit the bill.  My niece put the table together for my Mom and reported to me that it was a bit complicated, but she did it  I have included a pic for comparison.  My Mom reports that she absolutely loves it. She is going to use it when she wants to do a puzzle, or a little extra counter area. In the mean time, it folds down and sits again a wall, out of the way. I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Catskill Craftsmen Fold-A-Way Butcher Block Table
features: Made from Northeastern Hardwood in the Catskill Mountains. Made from Solid Wood. Made in the USA. Assembly Required.
Overall Dimensions Assembled: 36 in. wide by 24 in. deep by 30 in. high.
Overall Dimensions with both drop leaves up: 36 in. wide by 24 in. deep by 30 in. high.
Overall Dimensions with one drop leaf up: 18 in. wide by 24 in. deep by 30 in. high.
Overall Dimensions with drop leaves down: 10 in. wide by 24 in. deep by 3o in. high.
description: Catskill Craftsmen has become the nation's leading manufacturer of ready-to-assemble domestic hardwood kitchen islands, carts, and work-centers. Catskill Craftsmen manufactured items are made from naturally self-sustaining, non-endangered North American hardwoods, primarily Northern Yellow Birch. Lumber is purchased from area sawmills, then dried, manufactured, and packaged on site. All sawdust, shavings and waste materials generated during the manufacturing process is converted into wood pellet fuel, and used to heat homes. This dual drop leaf table has up to 36 inches of width when fully open, yet stores away with just a 10 inch wide footprint. Features swinging gate legs for complete stability, Northeastern Hardwood construction, and ships with an oil finish.
